issue.description: doctor --scope secrets fails with an I/O error and returns no findings when one retained generation root is unreadable. On 2026-10-03 that left 8 of 82 fleet workspaces with no verdict, including their live rows. Scan live rows, the current generation, and the previous generation independently. Add details.coverage with source, status (scanned, absent, unreadable), and reason_code. An unreadable source makes the check an error while every finding from the scanned sources is still returned; a previous generation that legitimately does not exist is absent and is not an error (ADR-025 item 3, secret-ruleset-v4 section 6, accepted secret-rejection-v1 section 5). Sequenced after beadrs-9e6f9b9e, which fixes the mode-transition cause in the same reader. Acceptance: a test removes the previous root and observes live findings plus an unreadable entry; a workspace before its second publication reports absent; recovery-artifact scanning stays report-only. Does not wait for BR-T35. Verify with the full Rust gates.
issue.notes: BR-T38 completed in af82722: doctor now treats only a truly missing checkpoint pointer as absent and reports dangling or unreadable sources as unreadable while retaining readable-source findings. Tests cover deleted previous roots through doctor details, absence after the first publication, dangling pointers, and report-only recovery. Shared targeted tests and Clippy passed; clean-archive definition-of-done --fast, full Clippy, and all focused acceptance tests passed. git push returned Everything up-to-date and origin/main..HEAD was empty. Shared cargo fmt saw unrelated concurrent file formatting; committed-tree formatting passed in the clean archive. Unrelated shared work was preserved.

issue.description:
## Scope
Build and execute the full release-gate test matrix, then generate a comprehensive evidence report.

## Tasks
- Build two pinned bead-rs binaries: pre-feature (before attempt-resolution) and feature-enabled
- Execute full test matrix: both binaries × all test suites (compat, concurrency, recovery)
- Run cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings, cargo test, cargo package
- Run installed-binary smoke tests against both versions
- Document exact git commit hashes and binary versions used
- Generate evidence report with all test results, hashes, and commands
- Verify all acceptance criteria from parent bead are met

## Acceptance
- Two bead-rs binaries built and pinned with exact commit hashes
- Full test matrix executed: both binaries run all test suites successfully
- cargo fmt --check passes
- cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes
- cargo test passes for all test suites
- cargo package succeeds
- Installed-binary smoke tests pass for both versions
- Evidence report (EVIDENCE.md) contains:
  - Exact git commit hashes for both binaries
  - Binary version strings
  - Complete command lines used
  - All test results with exit codes
  - Verification that all outcomes/actions are covered
- Parent bead acceptance criteria fully satisfied
issue.title: Execute release-gate matrix and generate evidence report
